mainEntity.name: Should I remodel the bathroom before selling my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom remodel can help a home show better, but only if the improvements are aligned with local buyer expectations and your budget. Cosmetic updates often make more sense than a full luxury overhaul if you are selling soon. In many cases, a clean, updated, well-lit bathroom delivers more market appeal than an expensive custom design.
